relations.rationale: The race drawing a crowd does not indicate anything about who is the lead volunteer.
A lively crowd at the race is consistent with riders gathering near starting banners, a natural part of the event.
A lively crowd at the race supports the idea that cheers rose as cyclists sped off.
The race drawing a crowd doesn't specifically indicate Ben's actions with a stopwatch.
Ben being lead volunteer has no bearing on whether Kai booked the hall.
Ben's role as lead volunteer doesn't relate to the crowd's cheering during the race.
Ben being lead volunteer could plausibly explain him watching riders with a stopwatch, a volunteer duty.
Riders gathering near starting banners is consistent with organizers then checking registration against rider tags, a related sequential event.
Riders gathering near the banners has no bearing on Kai's past season ranking.
Organizers checking registration lists is unrelated to Rosa joking with Ben about the wind.
Checking registration lists at the start doesn't directly bear on preparations for the closing awards ceremony.
Kai booking the hall has no logical connection to Kai greeting Leo at the refreshment table.
Kai booking the hall could be part of preparations that support the event's closing ceremony taking place there.

Ben arriving earlier than Kai contradicts the idea that they were already together chatting when Rosa arrived, since it doesn't establish who arrived together first, but is broadly consistent since both could have arrived before Rosa.
Ben arriving earlier than Kai doesn't tell us anything about Ivo's arrival time.
Ben arriving earlier than Kai doesn't determine whether Leo was there since dawn.
Ben's arrival time relative to Kai has nothing to do with Rosa's height compared to Kai.
Ben arriving earlier than Kai doesn't affect whether Rosa joked with Ben about the wind.
Ben's arrival time relative to Kai is unrelated to Ben's age relative to Ivo.
Ben and Kai chatting near the finish line when Rosa arrived doesn't indicate anything about relative heights of Rosa and Kai.
